summary.text: Log in to AIC’s eService portal with Singpass, then update the bank details for your CareShield Life or ElderShield claim payouts.

details.heading: Changing details for someone else
details.body: If you are changing the nominated bank account for a care recipient who lacks mental capacity, you need to submit a Mental Incapacity Certification if you have not done so before. Refer to Additional Guidance on AIC’s website for more information.

steps.name: Log in to AIC’s eService portal
steps.text: Go to https://efinance.aic.sg and log in with your Singpass.

steps.name: Update your bank details
steps.text: Update your bank account details for your CareShield Life or ElderShield claim payouts.

sources.page_title: How do I update my bank account details for my CareShield Life/ElderShield payouts?

quotes.text: You can log in to AIC’s eService portal (https://efinance.aic.sg) with your Singpass to update your bank account details for CareShield Life/ElderShield claim payouts.

If you are changing the nominated bank account on behalf of a care recipient who lacks mental capacity, you will need to submit a Mental Incapacity Certification if you have not done so before. Please refer to Additional Guidance on AIC’s website for more information.
